title: Monitor says No Signal
symptom: Monitor power light is on but shows No Signal
user_description: Someone moved my desk this morning. Now my monitor says 'No Signal' but the monitor light is on and the PC seems to be running.

options.why: Premature and costly. Nobody has yet checked the cable or the monitor input.
The driver cannot be the cause if the monitor is receiving no signal at all. Check the physical connection first.

options.text: Check the video cable is firmly connected at both ends and the monitor input source matches the cable (HDMI, DisplayPort or VGA)
options.why: A desk move often loosens cables. 'No Signal' also appears when the monitor is set to a different input than the one the cable uses.

options.text: Replace the monitor with a new one
options.why: Premature. A monitor that is on and says No Signal is working; it is just not receiving a picture. Check the cable and input first.

hints: The monitor is on, so what is it not receiving?
Monitors often have several input ports. How does it know which one to show?
real_world_tip: Press the Input or Source button on the monitor and cycle through the options. This fixes a surprising number of No Signal tickets.
